content: The title of the patient information page should include the name of the disease followed by (patient information). Only the first letter of the heading should be capitalized. The purpose of the patient information page is to provide a detailed and comprehensive description of the disease. The content should be written at a 5th to 8th-grade reading level. If medical terminology is used, it must be clearly explained. Examples of well-constructed patient information pages include those on chronic stable angina and pericarditis. These can serve as references. As with all microchapter pages, you must include a link to the main page. At the top of the edit box, insert {{CMG}} and your name template if you have made significant contributions to the page. Before this section, create a link back to the main page by typing in the edit box: For the WikiDoc page for this topic, click [here]. This statement should be bolded. Follow the format, headings, and capitalization guidelines as outlined in the template. Ideally, patient information pages should be created by directly adapting content from the physician's page. To use a patient information page template, you should utilize the patient information navigation template. This can be accessed by clicking [here]. Open the edit tab and copy all the text in the edit box. Then, type into the main WikiDoc search box: template: (disease name) patient information. Click on the link that says create the page (disease name) patient information here. Open the edit box and paste all the copied information. At the top of the edit box, there are two blank fields. The top field has binocular icons next to it, and the bottom field has red arrows. In the top field, type the condition name. In the bottom field, type the name of the disease page you are creating, ensuring the first letter is capitalized. Click the red arrows on the right side of the bottom field and continue clicking until you reach the end of the edit box. This process will place the disease name in the correct microchapter navigation boxes. Finally, click save at the bottom of the edit box. Search for the patient information page you want to create and click where it says create the page (disease name) (patient information) on this wiki. In the edit box, type {{disease name (patient information)}}. To copy and paste the headings template for the patient information page, click [here]. Overview This section should provide a concise description of the disease, with the name of the disease included in the first sentence. For an example of an overview section, click [here]. What are the symptoms of (disease name)? In this section, list the symptoms that the patient may notice. Remember that symptoms are subjective experiences reported by the patient, while signs are objective findings observed by a healthcare provider. For an example of a symptoms section, click [here]. What causes (disease name)? This section should list the causes of the disease. It is important to differentiate between what causes the disease and what the disease itself causes. For an example of a causes section, click [here]. Who is at highest risk? This section should outline the most common risk factors for developing the disease. If appropriate, divide the risk factors into modifiable and non-modifiable categories. For an example of a risk factors section, click [here]. Diagnosis In this section, describe what the patient might expect during the diagnostic process. Include a list of diagnostic studies with brief descriptions, such as blood tests, urine tests, and relevant portions of the physical examination. For an example of a diagnosis section, click [here]. When to seek urgent medical care? This section should focus on symptoms that may indicate life-threatening situations or significant worsening of the condition. For an example of this section, click [here]. Treatment options This section should outline the available treatment options, including medications, lifestyle changes, and surgical interventions. Advise the patient to always follow the treatment plan provided by their doctor. For an example of a treatment section, click [here]. Where to find medical care for (disease name)? Provide links to reputable sources where the patient can find appropriate treatment for their condition. Prevention In this section, describe factors that can prevent the onset of the disease or prevent its progression. For an example of a prevention section, click [here]. What to expect (Outlook/Prognosis)? Provide a brief statement about the prognosis of the condition. Include the expected outcomes with and without treatment, as well as the likelihood of specific outcomes. For an example of a prognosis section, click [here]. Possible complications List the common and most significant (life-threatening) complications of the disease or its treatment. For an example of a complications section, click [here]. Sources Include the sources of your information in this section. The National Library of Medicine is a reliable reference for patient information pages. Things to Remember Include a link back to the physician's page at the top of the patient information page. Always place {{CMG}} at the top of every page. Never use content directly from a source without verifying copyright compliance. Place your patient page in the patient information category and any other relevant doctor categories. To categorize a page, use the appropriate code. Create hyperlinks for key terms and diseases, ensuring they link to other patient information pages rather than regular WikiDoc pages. For example, heart failure should link to the patient information page for heart failure, not the general WikiDoc page.
